info.name: Payment Service API
info.description:
# Reusable SaaS Payment Microservice Collection

This Postman Collection provides end-to-end testing for all payment service endpoints.

### ⚡ Automatic Variable & Token Population:
- **Admin Authentication**: Pre-configured with `{{admin_api_key}}` loaded from your `.env`.
- **Application Registration**: Running **Admin > Create Application** automatically extracts and sets `{{api_key}}`, `{{app_id}}`, and `{{webhook_secret}}` for all subsequent requests.
- **Deposit Orchestration**: Running **Deposits > Initiate Deposit** automatically generates dynamic references, unique UUID idempotency keys, and captures `{{payment_id}}` and `{{payment_reference}}`.
- **Payout Orchestration**: Running **Payouts > Initiate Payout** auto-generates references and captures `{{payout_id}}` and `{{payout_reference}}`.
- **Refunds Orchestration**: Running **Refunds > Initiate Refund** auto-links to `{{payment_id}}` and captures `{{refund_id}}` and `{{refund_reference}}`.
- **Checkouts Orchestration**: Running **Checkouts > Create Checkout Session** auto-captures `{{checkout_id}}`, `{{checkout_code}}`, and `{{checkout_reference}}`.
- **Webhooks**: Running **Webhooks > Pawapay Callbacks** automatically reuses active transaction IDs (`{{payment_id}}`, `{{payout_id}}`, `{{refund_id}}`, `{{checkout_id}}`).
- **Key Rotation**: Running **Admin > Rotate Key** automatically updates `{{api_key}}` seamlessly.
